preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices ai and bi, both between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ci <= 10**4 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge has a flow volume ci between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m direction values, one for each edge.

postconditions.expression: all(di in {0, 1} for di in directions)
postconditions.description: Each direction value di is either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if (ai == v and directions[i] == 0) or (bi == v and directions[i] == 1)) == sum(ci for ai, bi, ci in edges if (ai == v and directions[i] == 1) or (bi == v and directions[i] == 0)) for v in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: For each vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of flow volumes of incoming edges equals the sum of flow volumes of outgoing edges.

postconditions.expression: all(ai != 1 or directions[i] == 0 for i, (ai, bi, ci) in enumerate(edges))

postconditions.description: The directed graph does not contain any cycles.
